description: This file contains utility functions for managing Kubernetes resource maps, annotations, and plugin source root detection within the kustomize project.

methods.name: GoBin
methods.description: Returns the path to the Go binary based on GOROOT.

methods.name: DeterminePluginSrcRoot
methods.description: Guesses the plugin source root directory based on various environment and directory checks.

methods.name: FileYoungerThan
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and is younger than a specified duration.

methods.name: FileModifiedAfter
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and was modified after a specific time.

methods.name: FileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.

methods.name: GetResMapWithIDAnnotation
methods.description: Returns a copy of a resource map with resource IDs annotated.

methods.name: UpdateResMapValues
methods.description: Updates resource map with new resource values generated by plugins.

methods.name: removeIDAnnotation
methods.description: Removes the ID annotation from a resource.

methods.name: UpdateResourceOptions
methods.description: Updates resource generator options based on annotations.
